title_en: The Robber Who Thought Lemon Juice Made Him Invisible
title_zh: 以为柠檬汁能隐身的劫匪

chunks.en: On 6 January 1995, McArthur Wheeler and an accomplice
chunks.zh: 1995年1月6日，麦克阿瑟·惠勒和一名同伙

chunks.en: **raided** two Pittsburgh-area banks at gunpoint
chunks.zh: 持枪**抢劫了**(raided)匹兹堡地区的两家银行，
align: 持枪**抢劫了**(raided)匹兹堡地区的两家银行，

chunks.en: **in broad daylight**, without **disguise**.
chunks.zh: **光天化日之下**(in broad daylight)，不加**乔装**(disguise)。

chunks.en: Their only **camouflage** was lemon juice,
chunks.zh: 他们唯一的**伪装**(camouflage)是柠檬汁，

chunks.en: **rubbed on** in the **earnest** **conviction**
chunks.zh: 是**抹上**(rubbed on)的，怀着**真心实意的**(earnest)**信念**(conviction)，

chunks.en: that it would **render** them invisible to cameras.
chunks.zh: 认为它能**让**(render)他们在摄像头前隐形。

chunks.en: The **rationale** had a **kernel** of truth.
chunks.zh: 这套**理由**(rationale)倒也有几分真实的**内核**(kernel)。

chunks.en: Lemon juice is a **time-honoured** invisible ink,
chunks.zh: 柠檬汁是一种**由来已久的**(time-honoured)隐形墨水，
chunks.note: （用柠檬汁在纸上写字，干后看不见，加热才显出字迹）

chunks.en: and Wheeler made an **inventive** **leap** from paper to skin.
chunks.zh: 惠勒则做了一次**富有创意的**(inventive)**跳跃**(leap)，从纸面跳到了皮肤上。

chunks.en: His Polaroid **self-portrait** came out **devoid of** its subject,
chunks.zh: 他那张宝丽来**自拍照**(self-portrait)显影出来，**全无**(devoid of)本人的身影，

chunks.en: a result he took as **conclusive**.
chunks.zh: 这一结果，他认定**确凿无疑**(conclusive)。

chunks.en: The security cameras **begged to differ**.
chunks.zh: 监控摄像头**恕难苟同**(begged to differ)。

chunks.en: On 19 April the eleven o'clock news
chunks.zh: 4月19日，11点新闻

chunks.en: showed **viewers** the **damning** images,
chunks.zh: 向**观众**(viewers)播出了那些**足以定罪的**(damning)画面，

chunks.en: and Wheeler was arrested shortly after midnight.
chunks.zh: 午夜刚过不久，惠勒就被捕了。
align: and Wheeler was arrested shortly after midnight.
午夜刚过不久，惠勒就被捕了。

chunks.en: **Confronted with** the tapes,
chunks.zh: **面对**(Confronted with)录像，

chunks.en: he protested in **sheer** **disbelief** that he had worn the juice.
chunks.zh: 他在**极度的**(sheer)**难以置信**(disbelief)中辩称，自己明明抹了柠檬汁。
align: 在**极度的**(sheer)**难以置信**(disbelief)中辩称，
that he had worn the juice.

chunks.en: Reading about the case,
chunks.zh: 读到这个案子时，

chunks.en: the Cornell psychologist David Dunning **pondered** a **disquieting** **proposition**.
chunks.zh: 康奈尔大学心理学家戴维·邓宁**思索**(pondered)起一个**令人不安的**(disquieting)**命题**(proposition)。

chunks.en: Perhaps **incompetence** can **cloak** itself,
chunks.zh: 也许，**无能**(incompetence)会**掩盖**(cloak)自身，

chunks.en: **robbing** people of the **discernment** to notice their **deficiencies**.
chunks.zh: **剥夺**(robbing)人们察觉自身**不足**(deficiencies)的**辨别力**(discernment)。

chunks.en: For a 1999 paper, Dunning and his student Justin Kruger
chunks.zh: 为了1999年的一篇论文，邓宁和他的学生贾斯汀·克鲁格

chunks.en: **quizzed** Cornell **undergraduates** on humour, grammar and **logical** reasoning.
chunks.zh: **测试了**(quizzed)康奈尔的**本科生**(undergraduates)，考查幽默、语法和**逻辑**(logical)推理。

chunks.en: The bottom quarter of **scorers** averaged the 12th percentile
chunks.zh: 垫底的四分之一**答题者**(scorers)，平均只处在第12百分位，

chunks.en: but **generously** placed themselves near the 62nd,
chunks.zh: 却**大方地**(generously)把自己估在第62百分位附近，

chunks.en: whereas **high achievers** showed **undue** **modesty**.
chunks.zh: 而**成绩优异者**(high achievers)却表现出**过分的**(undue)**谦虚**(modesty)。

chunks.en: The **unskilled**, the authors argued, bear a **dual** burden,
chunks.zh: **能力不足的**(unskilled)人，两位作者认为，背负着**双重**(dual)负担，

chunks.en: since **appraisal** calls for the same skills as **execution**.
chunks.zh: 因为**评估**(appraisal)需要的技能，与**执行**(execution)相同。

chunks.en: **Detractors** traced part of the Dunning-Kruger **disparity**
chunks.zh: **批评者**(Detractors)把一部分邓宁-克鲁格**差距**(disparity)

chunks.en: to regression to the mean,
chunks.zh: 归因于向均值回归，

chunks.en: a statistical **mirage** the paper **partially** acknowledged.
chunks.zh: 这种统计**假象**(mirage)，论文本身也曾**部分地**(partially)承认过。

chunks.en: Studies designed to avoid it
chunks.zh: 专为避开这一问题而设计的研究
align: 专为避开这一问题而设计的研究

chunks.en: still find a smaller but **tangible** effect.
chunks.zh: 仍发现了一个较小但**确实存在的**(tangible)效应。

chunks.en: In 2023 the pair **garnered** the Grawemeyer psychology award.
chunks.zh: 2023年，两人**赢得了**(garnered)格文美尔心理学奖。

chunks.en: **In fairness**, Wheeler had tested his method **empirically**
chunks.zh: **平心而论**(In fairness)，惠勒确实**用实验**(empirically)检验过他的方法——
align: 确实**用实验**(empirically)检验过他的方法——

chunks.en: before **staking** his **liberty** on it.
chunks.zh: 那是在他拿自己的**自由**(liberty)**下注**(staking)之前。
align: 那是在他拿自己的**自由**(liberty)**下注**(staking)之前。

chunks.en: The camera that missed him
chunks.zh: 漏拍了他的那台相机，

chunks.en: was the one he turned on himself.
chunks.zh: 恰恰是他对准自己的那一台。
align: the one he turned on himself.
